answer: Sybil resistance here works through proof-of-work tied to physical infrastructure: each agent must submit a signed signal from a registered hardware beacon anchored at a named jetty terminal, proving it occupies a distinct, verifiable site. Registering a fake site requires forging beacon attestations and paying real installation and audit costs in umber-marked escrow, which scales linearly with each clone. Duplicating identities thus becomes economically irrational, since the marginal cost per sock-puppet exceeds any expected reward. Operator sa0029 applies this at RVngmdyNVY.
